json_schema.title: file.touch
json_schema.description: Just like the touch command, create a file if it doesn't exist or simply update the atime and mtime if it already does

atime.ui:title: Access time
atime.ui:description: Access time in Unix epoch time. Set it to 0 to set atime of the file with Unix date of birth. If this parameter isn't set, atime will be set with current time.

mtime.ui:title: Modification time
mtime.ui:description: Last modification in Unix epoch time. Set it to 0 to set mtime of the file with Unix date of birth. If this parameter isn't set, mtime will be set with current time.
